payload.body: You tend to reach for closeness, recognition, or pleasure and then pull away as soon as the response matters. The desire feels manageable at a distance and risky once another person can answer it. Underneath is often the lesson that wanting exposed the part of you most likely to be hurt. Make the current request small enough to hear the current answer.
payload.astroHint: Lilith square Chiron can make wanting something reactivate an old expectation of judgment or rejection.
